root_cause_analysis.root_cause: TLD (frozen, SHA256 022f5c21) table detection algorithm only recognizes tables on specific page layouts
root_cause_analysis.details: TLD uses column alignment detection; construction pipeline uses geometric filter (h_gap 8-50pt). Two methods have different coverage. TLD detects tables on 14 past pages + efficientnet p2. All other pages (including all med_001 pages) have 0 TLD table detections despite having sufficient VLines.

repair_options.only_legal_path: Corpus expansion with TLD-detectable table documents (outside this task scope)

final_answer.question: 是否存在足够独立的 Future Cases？
